paragraphs: HelmSight is a responsive project-delivery management application for Project Managers and Delivery Managers. It brings project health, governance, risks, milestones, Earned Value Management (EVM), management actions, reporting, and meeting notes into one workspace. The application is being developed in phases, with backend and API integration planned for future releases.
features: Active and archived projects, restore actions, and persistent Grid / List views.
Project creation and editing, plus a seeded Atlas Modernization demo workspace.
Derived portfolio health: Healthy / Watch / Needs attention / Not assessed.
Project Overview with delivery signals, upcoming milestones, success criteria, management actions, and performance indicators.
Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts; persistent Light / Dark / System appearance settings.

whatItDoes.text: HelmSight is a responsive project-delivery management application for Project Managers and Delivery Managers. It brings project health, governance, risks, milestones, Earned Value Management (EVM), management actions, reporting, and meeting notes into one workspace. The application is being developed in phases, with backend and API integration planned for future releases.

requirements.text: Current limitations: no server API, shared database, sign-in/authorization, real-time multi-user collaboration, external integrations, AI features, or full resource/critical-path planning.
